sources.title: RESMP-DEV/Flint-40B-A2.5B-MLX-GPTQ-MXFP4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: An MLX-format conversion of RecursiveSI/flint, a mixture-of-experts coding model with 39.8B total parameters and about 2.5B active per token, quantized to MXFP4 (4-bit E2M1 elements, group size 32, per-group E8M0 scales) with activation-aware GPTQ calibration on Apple Silicon.

sources.title: Recursive Flint: Open 40B MoE Coding Model for Local Agents - ai-tldr.dev
sources.snippet: It is a mixture-of-experts language model for coding agents — investigating codebases, fixing bugs, implementing features and writing tests — with 39.8B total parameters and approximately 2.5B active per token, which Recursive rounds to the size designation 40B-A2.5B.

sources.title: Recursive Flint 40B-A2.5B: The Fast Local Coding Model
sources.snippet: The number that decides whether Recursive Flint 40B-A2.5B is worth your disk space is not 54.9%. It is 2.5. Recursive's first open-weight coding model carries 39.8 billion parameters and wakes up roughly 2.5 billion of them for each token it writes, and almost every other decision in the release — the attention layout, the quantisation recipe, the custom Metal kernel, the inference engine ...

sources.title: Recursive releases its first model, Flint: a 40B-total, 2.5B-active ...
sources.snippet: On Oct 21, Recursive, the startup founded by Richard Socher, released its first model, Flint: a 39.8B-total MoE coding model with about 2.5B active parameters per token, with weights on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0. Recursive says it leads sub-50B MoE models on SWE-Bench Pro v2, Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-Bench Verified, runs at 125+ tok/s on an M4 Pro MacBook Pro, and was built from scratch ...
